requirement: The data warehousing system shall compute and store a cryptographic digest for every loaded data extract so that any later change to the extract can be detected.
The sales forecasting system shall attach a hash value to each imported sales dataset and reject any dataset whose recomputed hash differs from the recorded one.
The online booking system shall protect each confirmed reservation record with a message authentication code that is verified before the record is displayed or processed.
The online booking system must allow an administrator to run a verification of the stored reservation records that reports any record that has been altered since it was saved.
The simulation software shall let a researcher validate that saved model parameters and result files have not been modified since they were written.
The online banking application shall provide an auditor with a function to confirm that stored transaction records match their original recorded checksums.
The screen capture tool shall prevent any process other than the authorised capture session from modifying or deleting recordings that have already been saved.
The sales forecasting system must restrict write access to historical sales figures to authorised analysts so that unauthorised users cannot change the figures used in forecasts.
The database server shall reject any attempt by an unprivileged account to insert, update or delete records in protected tables.
The screen capture tool shall require each user to prove their identity with valid credentials before a recording session can be started.
The compiler shall require a developer to present valid credentials before it accepts a build request on the shared build service.

The data warehousing system shall verify the X.509 certificate presented by an analyst at sign-in and shall reuse that verified identity for other connected reporting tools while the session remains valid.
The smart-home IoT controller must accept a paired device only after validating the device's signed certificate against a trusted issuer.
The smart-card electronic purse shall confirm the cardholder's identity by relying on an external trusted identity provider reached over the network before enabling a top-up.
The simulation software must let a researcher sign in using an identity assertion issued by a recognised third-party identity provider.
The smart-home IoT controller shall allow the homeowner to check that camera snapshots kept in storage have not been changed since they were captured.
The data warehousing system must enable a data steward to run a check that proves archived fact tables are identical to the versions originally loaded.
The database server shall offer an administrator a command that validates stored data pages against recorded checksums and reports every mismatch.
The hospital patient-record system shall validate the certificate chain and expiry of the server certificate before clinicians' workstations exchange patient data with it.
The online banking application must check that the TLS certificate of its server is valid, issued by a trusted authority and unaltered, and must warn the operator when the check fails.
The screen capture tool shall verify the validity and trust chain of the upload server's certificate before transmitting any recording.
The compiler's online account portal shall let a registered developer who has lost access obtain a reset of the credential through a link sent to the email address on file.
The web browser's sync service must allow a user to regain access to an existing account by confirming ownership through a message sent to the registered email address.
The simulation software shall grant a researcher access to the project workspace only after the researcher supplies a secret passphrase that matches the one registered for that account.
The hospital patient-record system must admit a clinician only when the clinician enters a registered secret that meets the complexity rules defined by the hospital.
The smart-home IoT controller shall ensure that every command received from the user is carried out exactly as specified and that the resulting device state matches the command.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system must calculate and record salary figures exactly as defined by the pay rules, without any unintended alteration of stored values.
The database server shall apply each committed statement so that the stored data remain correct and consistent with the statement's intended effect.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system shall identify each staff member at sign-in by a secret code that is checked against the one registered for that person.
The web browser must verify the identity of a user unlocking the saved-credentials store by requiring a master secret of at least eight characters.
